title: Mean field limits of large Jackson networks in heavy traffic
summary: We consider an open Jackson network with $n$ exchangeable single-server stations and weak all-to-all interaction through routing: upon service completion at station $i$, a job is routed to station $j$ with probability $p/n$, where $p\in(0,1)$, or leaves the system with probability $q=1-p$. We study a joint asymptotic regime in which the number of stations tends to infinity while the system approaches heavy traffic.
